_what: What Groq's documentation CLAIMS. Hypotheses, not measurements (CLAUDE.md rule 1). The probe confirms or refutes each claim and writes its findings elsewhere.
scope_claim: Rate limits apply at the organization level, not to individual users. 'You can hit any limit type depending on which threshold you reach first.'

headers_claimed.note: the docs call their example header values illustrative

other_claims.429: exceeding a limit returns 429 Too Many Requests
other_claims.cached_tokens: cached tokens do not count towards rate limits

whether TPM/TPD are charged on max_tokens at admission or on actual usage
whether a 429-rejected request counts toward RPD or TPM
whether a cancelled stream is charged in full
